title: Super Morning Star
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High-schooler Honda learns that his feared classmate Kaido secretly works as a suit actor in a children's sentai live show; they become friends, then Honda impulsively reveals the secret to the class and must repair the damage (Kodansha blurb; Anime UK News vol. 1). Later volumes follow them as adult partners after high school: homophobic bullying by Kaido's fellow actors, a breakup and reconciliation, a private proposal and meeting each other's families (Anime UK News vols. 2 and 4). A four-volume boys' love series.
life_message: It holds up honest, faithful love between two men that survives career pressure and prejudice.

content.note: Publisher warning lists 'homophobic bigotry and violence'; Kaido bullied by co-workers (vol. 2 review); judo challenge from his grandfather (vol. 4).
Emotionally raw breakup and cliffhangers (vol. 2 and 4 reviews).
Explicit consensual sex scenes between the adult couple; vols. 2-4 rated Mature 18+, shrink-wrapped (reviews; MangaUpdates Yaoi). High-school volume 1 is Older Teen 16+, kissing only by vol. 2.
Insults such as 'thug' (vol. 1 review); not otherwise described.
Honda outs Kaido's secret job to the class and hurts him (vol. 1 review); possessive lover dynamic (MangaUpdates).
